title = Infantry I: Submachine Gunner
20mhit = 20 m target hit! 50mhit = 50 m target hit! 100mhit = 100 m target hit! Good shooting. 200mhit = 200 m target hit! Well done! 500mhit = 500 m target hit! Excellent! gunrange = Firing Line bunker = Sandbag Pit vehiclerange = Vehicle Target Range
1.0.label = The Submachine Gun
1.1.label = Intro 1.1.alert.modal = The submachine gun ("SMG") is a very powerful weapon when used correctly. It is best used at close range.
1.2.label = Firing Position 1.2.alert = Move forward to the firing line. #waypoint label: "Firing Line" #waypoint: -314046.54,3603720.08,101.73
1.3.label = Firing 1.3.alert = The SMG can be fired from the hip, but this sprays a wide area with little control.[NL][NL]Press {fpfire} to fire the weapon. 1.3.complete.modal = This can still be effective against a close enemy, but is not reliable.
1.4.label = Aiming 1.4.alert = When aiming the SMG, it is possible to achieve a high degree of accuracy by using short, controlled bursts.[NL][NL]Hold {fpgunsight} to aim the SMG.
1.5.label = Fire 1.5.alert = Now aim and fire the weapon at the 20 m targets by pressing {fpfire}.[NL][NL]Reload the weapon with {fpreload} if you are low on ammo.[NL][NL]Hit any target to continue. 1.5.complete.modal = Good!
1.6.label = Recoil 1.6.alert.modal = Recoil makes it difficult to aim well while firing the SMG. 1.6.alert1.modal = Press and hold {fpfire} to fire a complete magazine of ammunition. Use {fpreload} to reload. 1.6.alert2.modal = Notice how the weapon climbed higher and higher as you continued to fire. You can reduce this by aiming while firing.[NL][NL]Press and hold {fpfire} and {fpgunsight} to fire a complete magazine of ammunition. 1.6.alert3.modal = You can minimize the recoil even more by pulling down as you fire while aimed.[NL][NL]Fire another magazine while pulling your gunsight down. 1.6.complete = Good. With practice, you will be able to accurately fire an entire magazine on a target. 1.7.label = Done 1.7.alert.modal = You now know the basics of using a Submachine Gun.
content.brief: Learn how to use a sub-machine gunner.
